entities.name: György Matolcsy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: György Huba Matolcsy is a Hungarian politician and economist who was governor of the Hungarian National Bank (MNB) for 12 years until March 2025. He previously served as Minister of National Economy from 2000 to 2002 during the first cabinet of Viktor Orbán and from 2010 to 2013 in the second Orbán Cabinet.
